behaviors.name: Buzz
behaviors.intent: Neon hums; now and then it stutters.
behaviors.source:
behavior Buzz
  var base = (1, 1, 1)
  var dead = 0
  on start
    base = self.scale
  end
  on tick
    if chance(0.004) then
      dead = 0.25
    end
    dead = max(0, dead - dt)
    if dead > 0 and sin(time * 90) > 0 then
      self.scale = (0.01, 0.01, 0.01)
    else
      self.scale = base
    end
  end
end

behaviors.name: Swim
behaviors.intent: The hologram swims in slow circles above the street, flickering.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let a = time * 0.4
  self.position = (cos(a) * 3, 15 + sin(time * 0.8) * 0.6, -18 + sin(a) * 3)
  self.rotation = (0, 0 - a * 57.3 + 90, sin(time * 2) * 8)
end

behaviors.name: Fall
behaviors.intent: Fall hard, slanted by the wind; start again at the top.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  move self by (-0.8 * dt, 0 - self.speed * dt, 0)
  if self.position.y < 0 then
    self.position = (random(-5, 5), 16, random(-30, 16))
  end
end

end
